EggAI · Banking transformation programme (UK) · Remote, UK-facing — London for gate weeks

About the Programme

EggAI is the transformation partner on a core banking system replacement for a client to lay the foundations of operating Agentic Generative AI in production.

EggAI's role is to specify, set the standard and programme-manage. You will define what operational readiness means and prove it at each gate, working with the client's own teams and its managed service providers, as well as EggAI's platform engineers.

The platform is a mix of classical banking infrastructure and agentic AI workloads, so the reliability problem runs across both deterministic and probabilistic systems.

The Role

Own the definition of operational readiness for go-live: what "ready to run in production" means, how the bank proves it at each regulatory gate, and what has to change in the organisation for that proof to hold.

The bank's operations teams, processes and provider contracts were built to run classical banking infrastructure. Agentic AI workloads need a different operating model, and you will shape it: redraw responsibilities between the client's teams and its managed service providers, set the standards each party works to, and lead the people through the change — so that those who run the platform today are ready and willing to run what comes next.

This is a lead/principal position reporting to the Programme Plan and Execution Lead. It is remote, with regular London presence required for gate weeks and workshops.

Responsibilities

  • Reliability targets — set the SLO and error-budget framework alongside the client's existing structure, have the service owners adopt it, and commission the behavioural quality measures that do the same job for agentic workloads

  • Observability and detection — define what Tier-1 services and agentic workloads must emit, including trajectory logging; require an automated path from a firing alert to the affected services and their owners; and hold the operating teams to closing the logging gaps in what runs today

  • The incident and change path — set the runbook standard and its required coverage, extend incident classification and intervention mechanisms to agentic failure modes, and have rollback and change-failure rates measured and reported by those who own them

  • Capacity and performance — direct the headroom position through the parallel-run peak at cutover, sponsor the chaos and game-day programme for payment rails and the core ledger, and mandate that capacity modelling covers inference workloads

  • Gate evidence — own the technical content of the Operational Acceptance Report and Operational Readiness Certificate, the reliability section of each gate pack, and the reliability NFRs defended as ADRs through the client's Architecture Design Authority — written by the teams, reviewed and signed off by you

  • The operating organisation — decide how responsibilities sit between the client's teams and its managed service providers for the new platform, and lead the people concerned through that change

Expected experience

  • 10+ years in leading IT operations teams — You have operated L1, L2, and L3 support as SRE, platform reliability or infrastructure organisations, with the people and the providers reporting to you

  • Aligns operations with development, engineering and the business — has set operating goals that engineering teams and business stakeholders signed up to, and kept them focused on those goals through delivery

  • Has introduced SLOs and error budgets into an organisation that did not have them, and can build on the experienced success factors

  • Infrastructure in depth — has deep infrastructure knowledge, and what is required for smooth business operations: telemetry, redundancies, backups, etc.

  • Incident management, with post-incident reviews that led to real changes in the system and in the organisation

  • Regulated financial services, or another environment where an external body audits operational evidence.

  • Has worked through a managed service provider and can set standards they do not personally execute

  • Comfortable operating in a complex, multi-stakeholder programme where scope and ownership are still being established across parallel workstreams

Valuable, not required

  • LLM or agentic system operations: eval harnesses, drift detection, trajectory analysis, prompt and model versioning treated as change types

  • Core banking or payments exposure, particularly scheme gateway integration

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a platform architect. A separate role owns agentic platform design and build

  • Not an on-call engineer. You will not carry a client pager; out-of-hours operations are run by a third party

  • Not a service delivery manager. This is engineering judgement applied to readiness, not ITSM process administration

·         À l’aise avec la recherche, l’analyse et la synthèse d’informations, ainsi qu’avec la rédaction de documents clairs.

Ce que NOVAR vous offre

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables.

 

Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte?

💰 Une gratification de stage de 900 € par mois, dans le respect de la réglementation en vigueur.

📚 Des opportunités de développement et de croissance au sein de notre scale-up international.

À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. 

 

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 7 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2035. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. title: Stage – IA générative & création de vidéos d’Activité Physique Adaptée (APA)
description:
My GOOD LIFE recrute !
Rejoignez un projet innovant à l’intersection de l’intelligence artificielle, de la vidéo et de l’Activité Physique Adaptée

My GOOD LIFE développe des solutions et des contenus visant à promouvoir l’Activité Physique Adaptée auprès de différents publics, notamment les personnes souhaitant reprendre une activité physique, préserver leur autonomie ou améliorer leur qualité de vie.

Dans le cadre de son développement, My GOOD LIFE souhaite intégrer l’intelligence artificielle générative à la conception de supports vidéo pédagogiques, accessibles et adaptés aux besoins des différents publics.

Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons notre futur(e) :

Stagiaire en intelligence artificielle générative et création de contenus vidéo APA (H/F)

Votre mission

Encadré(e) par notre équipe, vous participez à la conception et à la production de vidéos d’Activité Physique Adaptée grâce aux outils d’intelligence artificielle générative.

Votre mission consiste à expérimenter différents outils, concevoir et optimiser des prompts, générer des contenus vidéo et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de leur qualité pédagogique et visuelle.

À la fois créatif(ve), rigoureux(se) et curieux(se), vous participez à la construction d’une méthodologie permettant de produire des contenus cohérents, réalistes, accessibles et adaptés aux objectifs de l’Activité Physique Adaptée.

Vous intervenez notamment sur les volets suivants :

  • Concevoir, tester et optimiser des prompts destinés aux outils d’intelligence artificielle générative.

  • Générer des vidéos illustrant des mouvements, exercices et séances d’Activité Physique Adaptée.

  • Tester et comparer différentes solutions de génération vidéo, d’animation, d’avatars et, si nécessaire, de voix off.

  • Améliorer la fluidité des mouvements, la posture, la cohérence visuelle et la clarté des consignes proposées.

  • Participer à la création de contenus pédagogiques adaptés à différents publics et niveaux de pratique.

  • Analyser les résultats obtenus et faire évoluer les prompts afin d’améliorer progressivement la qualité des productions.

  • Formaliser une méthodologie de production en documentant les prompts utilisés, les outils mobilisés, les résultats obtenus et les bonnes pratiques.

Le profil que nous recherchons

Vous préparez une formation dans l’un des domaines suivants : intelligence artificielle, informatique, audiovisuel, multimédia, design numérique, création de contenus digitaux ou ingénierie pédagogique.

Vous êtes particulièrement intéressé(e) par les usages concrets de l’intelligence artificielle générative et souhaitez participer à un projet associant technologie, mouvement, sport et santé.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :

  • Votre intérêt pour les outils d’IA générative et de création vidéo ;

  • Votre capacité à expérimenter, comparer et améliorer les résultats obtenus ;

  • Votre sens de l’image, de la pédagogie et du détail ;

  • Votre autonomie, votre créativité et votre rigueur ;

  • Votre esprit d’initiative et votre curiosité.

Une première expérience avec des outils de génération vidéo par IA, de création d’avatars ou de montage vidéo constitue un véritable atout.

Une connaissance du domaine sportif, de la santé ou de l’Activité Physique Adaptée sera également appréciée.

Pourquoi rejoindre My GOOD LIFE ?

Ce stage vous permettra d’expérimenter concrètement les nouveaux outils de génération vidéo, de développer vos compétences en prompt engineering et de participer à la création de contenus ayant une finalité pédagogique et d’utilité sociale.

title: Ingénieur en mécanique des fluides
employer: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description:
ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

          

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet MULTIRIM, qui vise à développer des solutions innovantes en propulsion marine. Les propulseurs marins à entraînement circonférentiel constituent une alternative aux hélices classiques marines, en présentant plusieurs avantages : manoeuvrabilité, compacité, discrétion acoustique, amélioration de la traînée de la carène par l’absence de ligne d’arbre. Cependant, la présence d’une tuyère embarquant le moteur électrique d’entraînement pénalise le rendement. Une piste d’amélioration est d’adopter un propulseur à plusieurs étages à l’instar des moteurs d’avion, afin de regagner environ vingt points de rendement. La configuration même de l’entraînement extérieur, sans arbre, supprime la complexité mécanique rencontrée sur les hélices contrarotatives classiques.

Or, il existe très peu de bancs d’essai pour les propulseurs à entraînement circonférentiel, pour une seule hélice, ainsi que très peu de données expérimentales de référence. Les difficultés sont de deux ordres. Du point de vue fonctionnement, le refroidissement du moteur électrique nécessite des échanges thermiques, et la liaison rotor/stator est assurée par un palier hydrodynamique. La mise ne eau dans une veine hydrodynamique est ainsi obligatoire. Par ailleurs, l’absence d’arbre d’entraînement empêche une mesure aisée du couple d’entraînement, valeur requise pour déterminer le rendement global du propulseur.

Intégrer plusieurs étages propulsifs au sein d’un même propulseur au sein d’un banc d’essai expérimental n’a jamais été proposé au niveau international. Cependant, le mode de fonctionnement de l’entraînement circonférentiel le permet aisément.

Disposer de résultats expérimentaux de référence, tant pour les efforts globaux que pour l’écoulement (champ de vitesse, de pression) présente un intérêt fort pour la communauté scientifique. En particulier, l'écoulement fortement tourbillonnaire, la présence d'éléments tournants rendent la simulation numérique particulièrement difficile et des résultats de référence permettront de valider les modèles numériques.

Aussi, le premier objectif de ce projet est de développer un banc d’essais modulaire, afin de tester plusieurs configurations d’hélices, de vitesses d’entraînement différenciées, de formes de tuyère, et évaluer précisément le rendement global. D’autre part, le principe des moteurs à plusieurs étages est de récupérer la puissance perdue par le premier étage, en redressant l’écoulement, un propulseur idéal accélérant l’écoulement uniquement de manière axiale. Un second objectif du projet consiste à caractériser cette récupération d’énergie opérée par les étages supérieurs.

Le projet associe les compétences en modélisation de machines électriques de l’IRENav et les compétences en modélisation hydrodynamique de l’ENSTA-IRDL (UMR CNRS 6027) et de l’IRENav.  L’ENSTA met par ailleurs à disposition sa veine aérodynamique dédiée aux applications marines, et l’instrumentation associée. La caractérisation du rendement du propulseur sera réalisée par mesure directe des efforts, et mesure indirecte de la vorticité résiduelle dans le sillage aval à l’aide de mesures non intrusives du champ de vitesse (méthode PIV).

La personne recrutée sera amenée à produire des rapports et présentations techniques, mettre en œuvre des essais (étalonnage, mesure d’efforts, velocimétrie laser), et travailler de manière collaborative avec l’ensemble des partenaires du projet RD-PROP.

 

Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes :

 

Tâche 1 : Conception et fabrication d’un banc moteur dédié

 

La conception d’un banc d’essai propulseur s’appuiera sur les compétences de la plateforme de conception MASMECA de l’ENSTA, ainsi que sur l’expertise de l’IRENav sur les moteurs à entraînement circonférentiel. Le banc d’essai sera prévu pour être modulaire, et fonctionner dans une gamme de vitesses de rotation représentative d’un propulseur réel.

 

Tâche 2 : Détermination du rendement maximal atteignable

 

Parallèlement à la conception et la fabrication du banc moteur, un modèle semi-analytique (disque actuateur sous tuyère) sera développé, afin de proposer une estimation théorique du rendement maximal atteignable par un propulseur sous tuyère. Cette estimation prendra en compte la traînée de la tuyère, l’absence de flux transverse dans le sillage aval. La principale simplification concerne le frottement visqueux sur les pales, non pris en compte par ce type de modèle.

 

Tâche 3 : Méthodologie de quantification de l’écoulement transverse

 

Une méthodologie de détermination du champ de vitesses par technique PIV non intrusive dans un plan du sillage sera mise en œuvre, à l’aide d’un laser, d’une caméra rapide et d’un ensemencement de l’écoulement. L’influence de la position de la section transverse par rapport au corps étudié sera étudiée, ainsi que les paramètres numériques de l’algorithme PIV. Différents indicateurs de champ de vitesse intégré seront testés, pour qualifier au mieux la signature de perte de rendement lié à l’écoulement transverse. La méthodologie développée sera validée sur un écoulement classique de la littérature.

 

Tâche 4 : Mise en œuvre d’un benchmark de référence dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA

 

Le banc d’essai sera utilisé pour une première conception d’un jeu d’hélices contrarotatives (2 étages), adaptées au rim-driven, et d’une géométrie de tuyère simplifiée. Ces premiers tests exploratoires permettront de valider la chaîne complète de test (banc + instrumentation des efforts + post-traitement sillage aval) dans l’objectif de publier à terme un benchmark de référence au niveau international.

Le modèle hydrodynamique expert sera déterminé en suivant la méthodologie classique de l’ITTC, à l’aide d’une campagne d’essais dans la veine aérodynamique pour la caractérisation des efforts (essais en modèle captif du type PMM (Planar Motion Mechanism)). Ce modèle sera implémenté dans un simulateur temporel, dont les résultats seront confrontés sur des manœuvres standards réalisées dans le bassin à drones de l’ENSTA. La confrontation des résultats de trajectoires expérimentales aux trajectoires simulées, obtenues sur la base des essais en modèle captif, pourra amener à questionner la méthodologie standard, en particulier lors de la présence de non-linéarités importantes ou de termes croisés non négligeables. Les essais en bassin fourniront par ailleurs les données de cinématique nécessaires au travail de thèse.

 

Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes :

 

Tâche 1 – conception et fabrication d’un drone sous-marin

 

Conception d’un drone générique de géométrie simplifiée, et instrumenté. Le drone recevra un capotage extérieur, afin de tester plusieurs configurations : géométrie parallélépipédique typique d’un ROV d’exploration, et géométrie cylindrique de type drone torpille.

Le drone sera instrumenté pour mesurer les paramètres de contrôle, la cinématique et les trajectoires, ainsi que les efforts propulsifs (poussée, couple) et les efforts de contrôle.

 

Tâche 2 – essais statiques et dynamiques en modèle captif

 

Réalisation d’essais de caractérisation dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA, en similitude complète de Reynolds, pour les vitesses envisagées d’utilisation en eau du drone.

Mesure des efforts en statique, sur les 6 degrés de liberté. Caractérisation des efforts de plans porteurs et du propulseur.

Mesure des efforts en dynamique, en mouvement forcé à l’aide de l’hexapode : masses et inerties ajoutées, termes liés aux vitesses angulaires.

 

Tâche 3 – Identification dérivées hydrodynamiques

 

Identification des dérivées hydrodynamiques (ou coefficients hydrodynamiques) à partir des essais en modèle captif.

 

Tâche 4 – Adaptation du simulateur temporel

 

Prise en main du simulateur temporel de l’ENSTA, et de l’environnement de développement.

Adaptation du code de calcul pour intégrer des lois de commande issues de mesures expérimentales.

 

Tâche 5 – Essais libres et standardisés, en bassin

 

Réalisation d’essais aux trajectoires prédéfinies (zigzag horizontal ou vertical, accélération horizontale, …).

Réalisation d’essais pour parcourir l’espace complet des 6 degrés de libertés.

Enregistrement de l’historique des contrôles (vitesse hélice, angles plans porteurs, …), des trajectoires et des efforts des organes de contrôle.

 

Tâche 6 – Rejeu trajectoires simulateur temporel

 

Rejeu numérique des trajectoires, afin de valider si le modèle d’efforts est suffisamment complet pour prédire correctement les trajectoires mesurées expérimentalement.

 

Les résultats obtenus amèneront à publication scientifique.

Niveau de diplôme et formations

 

Thèse de doctorat dans le domaine de l’hydrodynamique navale.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.

Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. As a Systems Engineer in our Solutions team, you will help design the components and data flow of our core products: how data gets in, how deployments are configured and operated, and how everything scales across very different customer environments, many of them on-prem and air-gapped. 

You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success.

In particular, you will:

  • Build tooling and automation to simplify the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Exeon.NDR, Exeon.UEBA, log collection and supporting components 

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable log ingestion pipelines for a wide range of network and application log sources and formats, including parsing, normalization, and validation

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team.

Lead what comes next: With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products.

Our stack:

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

  • Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

  • DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

What we are looking for

Required:

  • Education: MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar.

  • Python: This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems.

  • Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics.

  • Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems.

  • Cloud & data: You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS.

  • Leadership attitude: You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader.

  • Languages: English. German is a big plus.

  • Hybrid setting: You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products.

  • Availability: 100%, as soon as possible.

  • Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position.

Preferred:

  • Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means.

  • Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools.

  • Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Mindset:

  • Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself.

  • Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you.

  • Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter.

Benefits

Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work.

Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company.

Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days.

Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out.

The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one.

Sounds like you?

Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points:

  • About you: A short description of yourself.

  • Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences.

  • Startup: Why do you fit a startup?

  • Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together.

  • Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it.

title: SAP Analytics Consultant
description:
We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne.   • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

  • Fluent French is essential

What We Offer:

  • A long-term engagement through 2029, renewable annually

  • Meaningful work supporting the financial and budget processes of a public-sector organisation

  • A broad and modern SAP Analytics landscape covering BW/IP, HANA, CDS, SLT, BO/Lumira and cloud analytics

  • A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

  • Collaboration within an experienced internal SAP Finance / Analytics team

  • Remote working after the onboarding phase

  • Opportunities to shape the client’s analytics architecture and future roadmap

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

  • Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

  • Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

  • Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

  • 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

  • 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

  • 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities

1. Storytelling That Converts

  • Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

  • Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

  • Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

  • Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution

  • Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

  • Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

title: IoT Engineer
description:

  • Experience designing and operating cloud-based ingestion and device fleet management systems for connected IoT devices at scale

  • Experience implementing OTA updates in production systems

  • Proficiency in a backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Node.js or Java) for device integration, automation and diagnostics, with excellent system-level debugging and problem-solving skills

  • Good written and spoken German and English

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.

What you will be doing

  • Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract
  • Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer
  • Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE
  • Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases
  • Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers
  • Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders
  • Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)
  • Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing

What we are looking for

  • A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company
  • A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets
  • Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written
  • Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH
  • A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking
  • Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC
  • Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools
  • Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus
  • Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus

How you like to work

  • Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.
  • A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.
  • Organized and independent: You can run several onboardings and pilots at once, and you're comfortable in a small regional team that works closely with colleagues in other countries and time zones.

If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Requirements

  • Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch.

  • Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms.

  • Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD or thesis, published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned.

  • Experience in the following fields an advantage but not strictly required:

  • The JAX ecosystem: Diffrax, Equinox, Optax, Lineax.

  • Plasma, fluid, electromagnetic, or other multiphysics simulation.

What we offer

title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

  • Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

  • Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

  • Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

  • PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

  • Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

  • Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities.

  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

  • Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

  • Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases.

  • AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories.


Job requirments:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.

  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and documentation.

  • Practical knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including:

    • Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps)

    • Power BI

    • Power Pages

    • Microsoft Dataverse

    • Data models, access structures, and data integrations.

  • Experience defining and refining Epics, Features, User Stories, and detailed Acceptance Criteria.

  • Knowledge of backlog management, refinement sessions, sprint planning, and PI Planning.

  • Experience with business process modelling, process flows, mockups, business rules, data mappings, and impact assessments.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
Senior Deal Desk Analyst - Dublin
Agentic AI Principal
AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day.

As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you.

You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together.

You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date.

You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence.

You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law.

You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter.

You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

  • You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years.

  • Strong experience in agentic AI.

  • You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

  • You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses.

  • You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough.

  • You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

  • You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs.

  • You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful.

  • Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

  • A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

  • Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

  • Base salary between €4,477 and €5,793 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

  • A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

  • 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

  • A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

  • A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

  • Collective insurance plans.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

  • Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

We'd love to tell you everything about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within 2 working days. Any questions first? Text or call Nadine at 0628556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you will take ownership of protecting our product, our users, and our collaborators as we scale a fast-growing AI companionship platform. Given the nature of our product (AI-generated content, including NSFW) you'll play a key role in keeping both our systems and our users safe, with real ownership from day one.

This is a hands-on role reporting directly to the Security Lead, with regular check-ins on priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Application Security

  • Perform weekly code reviews to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

title: Stage Software Development
description:
Stage Software Development 

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende (afstudeer) stage, waarbij je in aanraking komt met de nieuwste ontwikkelmethodes? Wil je ervaren hoe het is om mee te bouwen aan een platform dat wereldwijd wordt gebruikt door duizenden gebruikers? Dan is een stage bij IXON wellicht iets voor jou!


Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten en machines. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access,  geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld.


Bouw jij mee? 

Verdeeld over verschillende SCRUM-teams is ons R&D-team verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en  ontwikkelen van het IXON Cloud-platform. Elk aspect van onze oplossing, dan de robuuste backend tot de gebruiksvriendelijke frontend, geavanceerde hardware en onze wereldwijde DevOps-infrastructuur, wordt met passie en expertise binnen onze muren ontwikkeld. 


Ons R&D-team, dat inmiddels bestaat uit meer dan 30 technische specialisten, staat altijd open voor jonge talenten die willen groeien en zich verder willen ontwikkelen. Tijdens elke stageperiode bieden we meerdere plekken aan voor studenten in de volgende deelgebieden: 

  • Backend development; 

  • Frontend development; 

  • Embedded Software Development; 

  • DevOps; 

  • Security; 

  • Software testing. 


Hierbij kom je aanraking met onze tech-stack, bestaande uit: 

  • Python; 

  • C++;

  • Rust; 

  • Angular; 

  • Typescript; 

  • Playwright; 

  • Zabbix; 

  • Linux; 

  • MariaDB;

  • Kubernetes; 

  • SALT. 

Uiteraard staan we altijd open voor inbreng van studenten op het gebied van nieuwe tooling, frameworks en technieken. 


Welke opdrachten kan je verwachten?

  • Studio for e-mail

Door de aanhoudende groei van het aantal IXON Cloud-gebruikers neemt de diversiteit aan specifieke wensen toe. Een veelgehoorde behoefte is het personaliseren van e-mailberichten die vanuit het platform naar de eindgebruikers worden verstuurd. Momenteel zijn de aanpassingsmogelijkheden beperkt tot enkel de kleuren en logo's. Het doel van deze opdracht is om klanten volledige controle te bieden over de vormgeving en inhoud van hun e-mails. Om dit te realiseren, wordt een intuïtieve e-mailstudio ontwikkeld waarmee de gebruiker eenvoudig en naar eigen inzicht berichten kan opstellen en beheren.

  • Support Beckhoff ADS via pull application (Embedded Software Development)

Implementeer ondersteuning voor het Beckhoff ADS-protocol in C++ om de compatibiliteit van de IXON data pipeline te vergroten. Je realiseert de volledige koppeling op de gateway en maakt data-logging eenvoudig configureerbaar in de fleet manager.

  • Het versnellen van End-to-End (E2E) testen (Software testing)

Optimaliseer de End-to-End testomgeving van de IXON Cloud om de feedbackcyclus en release-snelheid voor ontwikkelaars te verhogen. Je identificeert knelpunten en implementeert versnellingsoplossingen binnen de GitLab CI/CD-pipeline.

Hier herken jij jezelf in 

Je bent een HBO student in de richting van (Embedded) Software Development, Security of aanverwant en bent op zoek naar een (afstudeer)stage met impact. Je hebt een passie voor het ontwikkelen van toffe softwareoplossingen en krijgt graag de vrijheid om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Daarbij ga je niet voor shortcuts, maar werk je gestructureerd aan kwalitatieve oplossingen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamplayer, die daardoor moeiteloos meedraait in een van onze SCRUM teams. 


Dit hebben wij jou te bieden 

  • Een mooie stagevergoeding;

  • Een relaxte werkomgeving met jonge en ambitieuze developers, met wie je altijd kunt sparren over de nieuwste technologieën;

  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen onze organisatie.

Tijdens deze stage van een half jaar (startende in februari) ga je aan de slag met de uitrol van Business Control binnen onze R&D-afdeling, waar dit op dit moment nog niet aanwezig is. Business control op R&D is best een uitdaging, want regels code tellen is niet de oplossing en de opbrengst van nieuwe producten is vaak nog lastig in te schatten. Jij gaat de uitdaging aan om toch controle te krijgen over de business!

Hoewel geen dag hetzelfde is, houd jij je tijdens een gemiddelde werkweek onder andere bezig met de volgende activiteiten:

  • De bestaande rapportagestructuur en kosten binnen de R&D-afdeling in kaart brengen;

  • Het maken van een concreet uitrolplan (waaronder het bepalen van KPI's, rapportages en reviews);

  • Meehelpen met rapportageverbeteringen en overkoepelend meekijken op de afdeling;

  • Wanneer er tijd is: een pilot draaien met één van onze teams om jouw theorie in de praktijk te brengen.


Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol 


Jij past perfect bij de pioniersgeest van onze organisatie. Dit betekent dat je niet bang bent om buiten de lijntjes te kleuren, initiatief te nemen en daardoor dus graag aan de slag gaat met nieuwe inzichten en projecten. Daarnaast ben je analytisch sterk, werk je graag zelfstandig en ben je van nature erg nieuwsgierig.

  • Je hebt de gedrevenheid om een complexe uitdaging, zoals het meetbaar maken van R&D, aan te vliegen.

Dit hebben wij jou te bieden

Binnen deze rol krijg je de vrijheid en kans om een cruciale rol te spelen in het succes van een organisatie met enorme internationale marktpotentie. Je maakt deel uit van een stimulerende en internationale werkomgeving, waarin je kunt samenwerken met getalenteerde en ambitieuze professionals en de ruimte krijgt om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Uiteraard belonen we je inzet met een mooie stagevergoeding en uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden, zoals:
